question: Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Swimming Pool Complex is located at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Swimming Pool Complex is an aquatic complex located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is situated in the Talkatora Indoor Stadium Complex.
 
• The complex was built for the 2010 Commonwealth Games held in New Delhi.
 
• The facility includes a competition pool, a warm-up pool, and a diving pool.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games 2010**

 
 
• The 2010 Commonwealth Games were held in New Delhi, India, from 3 to 14 October 2010.
 
• This was the first time the Commonwealth Games were held in India and the second time they were held in Asia (the first being in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in 1998).
 
• The Games featured 17 sports with more than 6,000 athletes from 71 Commonwealth nations and dependencies.
 
• India finished second in the medal tally, with a total of 101 medals including 38 golds.
 
 
 
• **Talkatora Indoor Stadium**
 
 
• The Talkatora Indoor Stadium is an indoor sports arena located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It is part of the Talkatora Garden complex, which is a historical park that dates back to the Mughal era.
 
• The stadium was extensively renovated and modernized for the 2010 Commonwealth Games.
 
• It has hosted various national and international sporting events, as well as cultural and political gatherings.
 
 
 
• **Aquatic Sports**
 
 
• Aquatic sports include a variety of competitive sports that take place in water, such as swimming, diving, synchronized swimming, water polo, and open water swimming.
 
• Swimming competitions typically include different styles such as freestyle, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.
 
• Diving involves athletes performing acrobatics while diving into the water from a platform or springboard.
 
• Synchronized swimming is a hybrid of swimming, dance, and gymnastics performed in the water.
